# Found First

> Founder-led AI marketing: answer engine optimization and ChatGPT advertising.

Contact: nick@modernapexstrategies.com

## Research library
- [Answer engine optimization services](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/answer-engine-optimization/): How Found First approaches AEO: buyer questions, technical access, useful answer content, supporting evidence, and measurable visibility.
- [ChatGPT ads management](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/chatgpt-ads-agency/): Managed ChatGPT advertising from eligibility and campaign strategy to creative, landing pages, conversion measurement, and reporting.
- [AEO vs. SEO vs. GEO](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/aeo-vs-seo-vs-geo/): A practical comparison of SEO, answer engine optimization, and generative engine optimization, including what to build and how to measure it.
- [AI visibility audits](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/ai-visibility-audit/): What an AI visibility audit should include: question selection, answer capture, source analysis, technical checks, and a prioritized action plan.
- [Getting recommended by ChatGPT](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/get-recommended-by-chatgpt/): A practical approach to ChatGPT visibility through accurate business information, useful pages, public evidence, and repeatable observation.
- [Google AI Overviews and AI Mode](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/google-ai-overviews/): Google AI search visibility starts with indexable pages, helpful content, clear internal links, and measurement that respects Search Console limits.
- [AEO content strategy](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/aeo-content-strategy/): Build an answer-content strategy around buying questions, original evidence, useful comparisons, and clear conversion paths.
- [Measuring AI marketing results](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/measure-ai-marketing-roi/): Separate AI visibility, referral visits, qualified inquiries, and revenue when evaluating AEO and ChatGPT advertising.
- [Choosing an AEO agency](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/choose-aeo-agency/): Questions to ask an AEO agency about evidence, scope, technical execution, reporting, founder involvement, and realistic outcomes.
- [ChatGPT advertising costs](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/chatgpt-advertising-cost/): Understand media spend, management, landing-page work, and measurement when planning a ChatGPT advertising test.
- [ChatGPT ads vs. Google Ads](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/chatgpt-ads-vs-google-ads/): Compare the roles of ChatGPT advertising and Google Search ads by buyer context, destination, measurement, and test design.
- [AEO for B2B and SaaS](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/ai-marketing-for-b2b-saas/): AEO for B2B software: use-case pages, integration details, fair comparisons, implementation answers, and qualified demo measurement.
- [AEO for ecommerce brands](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/ai-marketing-for-ecommerce/): AI marketing for ecommerce: clear product attributes, buying guides, useful comparisons, customer evidence, and purchase measurement.
- [AEO for professional services](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/aeo-for-professional-services/): Answer engine optimization for professional services: expertise, service fit, scope, attributable proof, and qualified consultation paths.
- [AEO for local businesses](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/aeo-for-local-businesses/): Local AEO connects accurate service areas, business profiles, useful service content, reviews, and clear booking or inquiry paths.
- [AEO for multi-location brands](https://nradachy-web.github.io/found-first/learn/aeo-for-multi-location-brands/): Multi-location AEO connects consistent brand information with accurate location pages, local evidence, centralized governance, and location-level outcomes.
